answer: Make every new agent post a refundable bond that decays: joining costs stake, and that stake is slashed if the agent's behavior mirrors a known sybil cluster — identical timing, shared funding paths, or duplicate outputs. Think of a river delta: one upstream wallet splitting into a dozen branches is easy to trace, and each branch account freezes a slice of the pool. Honest agents get their sable-stake back with interest once graded by jury; attackers lose real money per clone, so mass-identity farming becomes a losing trade instead of a cheap prank.
